title: Unique Glazed Australian Brussels Sprouts Skillet
description: A one-pot Australian dish featuring Brussels sprouts and rest-meat in a funky, glassy-jelly glaze, served in a fondue pot, diabetic-friendly and delicious.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large fondue pot over medium-high heat.
Add the diced rest-meat and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the trimmed and halved Brussels sprouts to the pot and cook until they start to brown, about 5 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the balsamic vinegar, honey, Dijon mustard, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and paprika.
Pour the glaze over the Brussels sprouts and rest-meat in the pot.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer, covered, until the Brussels sprouts are tender and the glaze is thick and syrupy, about 15 minutes.
Serve the Unique Glazed Australian Brussels Sprouts Skillet hot, directly from the fondue pot.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
